meta.title: 小精靈：史上最成功的街機遊戲
meta.subtitle: 探索披薩如何啟發岩谷徹創造出風靡全球的經典遊戲
meta.mainTitleEn: PAC-MAN: The Most Successful Arcade Game
meta.mainTitleZh: 小精靈：史上最成功的街機遊戲

content.contentEn: For Toru Iwatani, inspiration came from a pizza box. The shape of a pizza with one piece missing looked like a mouth, inspiring him to create Pac-Man—a hungry character going through tunnels to eat as much food as fast as possible while dodging colorful ghosts like Blinky and Clyde.
content.contentZh: 對岩谷徹來說，靈感來自披薩盒。少了一片的披薩形狀看起來像個嘴巴，啟發他創造出小精靈——一個飢餓的角色，穿梭於隧道中盡可能快速地吃掉食物，同時躲避布林奇和克萊德等彩色幽靈。

content.contentEn: In the late 70s, most successful games involved shooting and violence. Iwatani wanted to change this culture by creating a non-violent game that everyone, including women in particular, could enjoy. Pac-Man fit the bill and continues to draw players of all ages today.
content.contentZh: 在 70 年代末，大多數成功的遊戲都涉及射擊與暴力。岩谷想透過創造一款每個人（尤其是女性）都能享受的非暴力遊戲來改變這種文化。《小精靈》符合了這項要求，且至今持續吸引著各年齡層的玩家。

vocabulary.exZh: 我打算在週五下午前完成這個專案。

vocabulary.exZh: 許多青少年在電子遊樂場度過週末。

vocabulary.exEn: The army was prepared to defend the country against any invader.
vocabulary.exZh: 軍隊準備好保衛國家抵禦任何侵略者。

grammar.title: Who knew...?
grammar.desc: 反詰句，用來表達「誰會知道呢？」或「沒人料到」，強調事情出乎意料。
grammar.exEn: Who knew that inspiration could come from pizza?
grammar.exZh: 誰能想到靈感竟然來自披薩？

grammar.title: As... as could
grammar.desc: 用來強調程度或數量的極限。
grammar.exEn: He tried to eat as much food as fast as he could.
grammar.exZh: 他試圖以最快的速度盡可能吃掉更多的食物。

grammar.title: Fit the bill
grammar.desc: 慣用語，意指符合要求或合適。
grammar.exEn: Pac-Man fit the bill for a game everyone could enjoy.
grammar.exZh: 小精靈符合了一款每個人都能享受的遊戲要求。

quiz.question: Why did Toru Iwatani want to create Pac-Man?
options: To create a non-violent game for everyone.
quiz.explanation: 岩谷徹希望創造一款非暴力且男女老少都能享受的遊戲。

quiz.question: The new car is small and fuel-efficient; it perfectly __________ for the family.
quiz.explanation: fit the bill 意指「符合要求」。
